card.name: Inside the drug name daunorubicin
card.fires_on: The piece "un" in the middle of the drug name daunorubicin (written Da-un-orubicin), in chemotherapy labels. It responds right after "da" and before "orubicin".

modes.label: Sentence-initial Daunorubicin
modes.description: Capitalized Da-un at the start of a sentence or heading about the drug.

modes.label: Lowercase in dosing text
modes.description: Lowercase da-un in regimen or dose descriptions, often beside other anthracyclines.
modes.example: over 3 days and 45 mg/m 2 of idarubicin hydrochloride and 90 mg/m 2 of da<<un>>orubicin over a three-day period
